baseline_models.focus_anchor: كفروا بآيات ربهم ولقائه ... فلا نقيم لهم يوم القيامة وزنا
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus sequence joins covered signs, a refused face-to-face encounter, purposive deeds, resurrection, appraisal, and a just balance. The works reach the evaluative setting, but no worth or standing can be established for them.

activation_trace.role: Covering truth supplies the act that disconnects the deeds from acknowledged evidence.
A visible sign supplies the evidence being covered and the orienting marker for response.
Sovereignty and ownership make the signs and encounter answerable to one evaluative authority.
Two sides coming face to face makes the denied meeting an eventual confrontation.
Purposive action identifies what arrives for evaluation.
Valuation and appraisal make establishing weight an assignment of worth.
Rising and resurrection make the day of standing the setting of that appraisal.
The just balance supplies the norm under which worth would be established.

changed_reading.before: Their deeds are void, so no scale is set for them.
changed_reading.after: Their intentional deeds arrive at the resurrection encounter, but covering the Lord's visible signs leaves no just value or standing that can be established for them.

baseline_models.mechanism: The causal sequence allows h-b-t to retain its concrete pathology: harmful intake produces swelling and then collapse. Followed by measurement, the works can have conspicuous bulk while lacking sound, measurable substance.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the upstream enclosure within which the works take shape.
Swelling from harmful consumption gives the works apparent bulk produced by damaging intake.
Falling and collapse supplies the terminal failure of that swollen body of work.
Purposive action locates the pathology in real activity rather than inactivity.
Equal weight and moderate measure supply the sound proportion the swollen work lacks.
Estimation by weight tests whether apparent bulk contains measurable substance.

changed_reading.after: Their deeds may be active and voluminous yet pathologically swollen by bad intake; they collapse before measurement and yield no sound substance to weigh.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding description externalizes the focus root k-f-r as a sensory and interpretive enclosure: eyes are under a cover, the reminder is screened off, and hearing cannot become understanding or compliance. The failure of works thus begins before evaluation, at uptake of the signs that should orient them.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the focus action that the preceding sensory scene makes concrete.
The visible marker supplies what the blocked senses fail to receive as guidance.
The seeing eye supplies the perceptual channel placed under obstruction.
A screening cover gives k-f-r a concrete enclosure around perception.
A reminder that makes one remember supplies the orienting content kept outside the cover.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies the uptake explicitly unavailable to them.

structural_cues: 18:101 places eyes in a cover away from the reminder and denies capacity for hearing immediately before the focus verdict.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covering, seeing, reminder, hearing, and visible signs; I infer that blocked uptake misorients the later works. A live alternative is that 18:101 only characterizes the group and does not state a causal order.

changed_reading.before: Disbelief is a discrete proposition punished by loss of deeds.
changed_reading.after: Disbelief is also a maintained perceptual enclosure: visible signs and reminder do not become understood guidance, so deeds develop without the input needed to orient them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence places loss in works beside striving that misses its aim and confidence in skilled good making. Deficient measure, self-reckoning, comparison, and manufacture recast zero weight as a calibration failure: substantial effort can be competently produced to the wrong specification.

activation_trace.role: Appraisal and valuation supply the external assessment their self-assessment cannot establish.
Balancing two things supplies comparison between claimed goodness and evaluated worth.
Deficiency in measure gives loss in works a direct metrological edge.
Missing guidance or aim makes the effort's trajectory fail despite motion.
Purposeful movement toward a goal supplies real directed effort rather than idleness.
The split inventory's going on one's own course supplies the counter-image of drift within apparent striving.
Counting and reckoning supplies a self-generated measure of the work.
Assumption supplies the confidence by which that private reckoning is mistaken for fact.
Doing what is deemed good supplies the claimed quality of the output.
Skilled handcraft supplies competence and finish without guaranteeing evaluative fitness.

structural_cues: 18:103 names the greatest losers in works; 18:104 juxtaposes lost striving with their belief that they are making well.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies loss of measure, directed striving and drift, reckoning and assumption, goodness, and skilled manufacture; I infer a mismatch between an internal production standard and the focus scale. A live alternative is that good making denotes moral quality without a technical calibration image.

changed_reading.before: No weight means that little or no worthy work exists.
changed_reading.after: The work may be abundant, purposeful, and apparently well made, yet built to a self-authored measure; resurrection exposes a specification mismatch rather than a lack of exertion.

context_deltas.mechanism: False patronage before the focus and the final positive prescription form a relational test. The same meeting, Lord, and work vocabulary returns with fitting action and refusal of partnership, so the expected encounter functions as the horizon that makes work rightly directed and eligible to stand.

activation_trace.role: Face-to-face convergence supplies the denied relational horizon of the focus deeds.
Purposive action supplies the conduct whose orientation is at issue.
Taking and acquiring supplies the deliberate construction of an alternative allegiance.
Assuming protective charge supplies the role assigned to servants apart from the true Lord.
The repeated face-to-face encounter supplies the positive orientation explicitly hoped for.
Sovereignty and ownership identify the single relation governing encounter and worship.
Repeated purposive action mirrors the focus works while placing them under an imperative.
Fitness and suitability supply the quality required for work to match its relational end.
Partnership with God supplies the divided allegiance explicitly excluded from worship.

structural_cues: 18:102 asks whether deniers can take servants as patrons apart from God; 18:110 repeats meeting, Lord, and work in a positive prescription ending with no partnership.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed patronage, repeated meeting-Lord-work vocabulary, fittingness, and exclusion of partnership; I infer that orientation to the encounter makes deeds evaluatively coherent. A live alternative is that the mirrored vocabulary contrasts groups without making relational orientation the mechanism of weight.

changed_reading.before: Denial of the meeting and failed deeds are separate charges.
changed_reading.after: The meeting with the Lord is the organizing horizon of action: alternative patronage and divided worship reroute deeds, while hoped-for encounter and undivided service make action fitting.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next scale image is not a balance but an attempted material measure of the Lord's words: even a sea of ink plus replenishment is exhausted first. Beside the focus signs, works, and weight, this activates a mismatch between finite self-authored output and an inexhaustible revelatory measure.

activation_trace.role: Visible signs supply the revelatory markers against which the deeds were oriented or misoriented.
Comparison and counterbalancing supply the focus point for the following scale mismatch.
Vast abundant water supplies an immense but still finite material quantity.
Ink that feeds a pen converts the sea into a medium for materially registering words.
Connected increase and reinforcement supplies the attempted extension of that finite medium.
Meaningful expressions supply the divine content that exceeds the material register.
Exhaustion and ending supply the fate of the measuring medium rather than of the Lord's words.
The repeated sovereign identifies the words with the same Lord whose signs and meeting anchor the focus.

structural_cues: 18:109 follows the judgment contrast and repeats the Lord while staging a finite medium against unexhausted words.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies finite sea, ink, extension, exhaustion, the Lord's words, and focus comparison; I infer that this scale disparity sharpens why detached works furnish no counterweight. A live alternative is that 18:109 magnifies the words independently of the focus judgment.

changed_reading.before: No weight denotes only cancellation within a bounded ledger.
changed_reading.after: No weight can also mark incommensurability: finite work detached from the Lord's signs cannot furnish a counterweight to the inexhaustible measure disclosed by His words.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets the trumpet-blowing inventory activate bodily swelling and pride across domains. It remains anchored in h-b-t's harmful bloating and collapse and w-z-n's measurement; downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy, not as the lexical meaning of the trumpet.

activation_trace.role: Harmful bloating supplies the focus body's deceptive enlargement.
Collapse supplies the failure hidden behind that enlargement.
Measurement by weight tests the substance of the enlarged work.
Inflation by air supplies a hollow analogue for apparent volume without density.
Puffed pride supplies a social-affective analogue for self-enlarged works.

changed_reading.before: H-b-t pictures deeds ruined by harmful intake.
changed_reading.after: The neighboring blowing image tentatively sharpens the ruin as hollow or pride-filled inflation: impressive volume collapses and proves weightless.

strongest_changes: 18:101 turns covering into a perceptual enclosure that deprives work of orienting input.
18:103-104 turns zero weight into failed calibration of purposeful, apparently skilled work.
18:110 makes hoped-for encounter and undivided service the relational orientation that renders work fitting.
summary.what_was_special: The focus couples juridical q-w-m and w-z-n language with h-b-t's bodily collapse, allowing the same deeds to have activity and bulk yet lack substance, standing, and value.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether no weight is primarily literal balance imagery, nonvaluation, or denied standing remains open.
The scale link to 18:109 and the hollow-inflation link to 18:99 are abductive analogies rather than packet-stated causal relations.
